text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both treading water with minor losses, suggesting traders are holding rather than capitulating or rushing in. The Fear & Greed index at 66 with a rising trend indicates cautious optimism, though the $92B daily volume—healthy but not exceptional—implies conviction remains measured across the board. Bitcoin's dominance at 58.5% reflects steady positioning in the majors, while altcoins like BNB showing sharper declines hint at selective risk-off in the broader ecosystem.
